releases.notes: Version 1.0.0, the first full release. Install by USB from the Forbes Automotive updater page: coming from 0.39.7 or older the flash layout changes, so this erases the gauge. Press Download Backup (Settings > Device) first, then Import Backup after. New since 0.45.1: gauge fonts (VDO, Smiths, Stack, Defi, Digital LCD and car-maker styles), pull-down quick actions (layout, peaks, sprite, units), Update Now on the glass for the daisy chain, faster shared settings across the chain, the screen's dashed lines fixed, VAG PQ intake temp and boost from Motor_3 / Motor_7, gear decoding checked for VAG PQ / MQB and the BMW 8HP, Scan My Car fills the gauges from a scan.

Beta. Install by USB from the Forbes Automotive updater page, not over WiFi: the flash layout changed in 0.39.8, so this erases the gauge. Press Download Backup (Settings > Device) first, then Import Backup after. New since 0.39.7: touch screen support, peak marker on every gauge, Metric (UK) units, simpler sprite reactions, WiFi sleep, Haldex quick settings, faster Scan My Car, many fixes.

This update resets every setting: press Download Backup (Settings > Device) first, then Import Backup after. New: First Boot and Scan My Car find every value the car has and suggest gauges and triggers, and can set the other gauges up the same; every Menu and Tabs item is on the screen's menu, with Navigation, usb2ip, Oil and Triggers screens; Update All Gauges from any gauge; Drag Timer; Simos 18; K-line OBD-II on any make; many fixes.

First public release: 8 gauge pages in 12 styles from CAN, K-line, OBD (wired or Bluetooth / WiFi dongle), adc2can, usb2ip ECUs and UDS / TP2.0 diagnostics with a DID library; daisy chain with gauge-to-gauge updates, triggers, data logger, fault codes and module scan.
